reason: Refuted under the schedule and feasibility lens. The chance of a SCORED probe by 29 Sep 10:00 UTC is about 0.15-0.2 unconditionally, well under the 0.7 bar. The port pipeline itself is fast. Its headline is 'no public notebook scores above 0.953'. The only notebooks >= 0.950 are x138 and a verbatim re-upload (kunaldesale2408, whitespace diff). amanatar/optimized-biohub-max-score (x138 + in-sample PP sweep) is at best 0.953, its current version ERRORED, and its last good run scored 0.910. raunakdey07 V5 is x138 with the comments stripped. Tennant (now rank 45, 0.959, last submission 24 Sep 23:55) has published nothing new. On today's LB, 401 teams are >= 0.953, 240 sit at exactly 0.953 and 39 are >= 0.960. That leaves ~122 teams at 0.954-0.959, and all of them are private. After 4 days of a 240-team copy wave, nobody has released x138+something. (2) Unconditional P, as GUESSES: P(a release >= 0.955 that we see by 29 Sep ~07:00 UTC) ~0.2. That is below the idea's 0.3, since today's full scan is null and silver-zone authors lose rank by publishing. Many 'final' notebooks go public only AFTER the deadline, when they are useless to us. Multiply by P(all datasets public and attachable) ~0.85 and by P(the verbatim fork runs and submits in time) ~0.9: the result is ~0.15. (3) Resource lines in the idea are wrong. (a) This container cannot reach Kaggle: curl to www.kaggle.com/api/v1 returned 000 here, and the proxy blocks it by policy. The 'agent-container 2 h' pull/diff/fork step must therefore run on the user's laptop session, which already has the Kaggle CLI (browser_intel.md header). So the user's offer to paste a Kaggle API key into this chat would not help this container, and a secret should not be pasted into a chat anyway. (b) 'build_probe_kernel --base x138' works only for the rider onto x138. --base accepts only {exp39, x138} (tools/build_probe_kernel.py l.79-82, l.1373). A successor base would need a new BASES entry (sha256 plus cell indices) and anchor repair, ~1-3 h. (4) What is NOT a constraint: GPU (x138's visible-test run takes 20m28s on T4 x2, so a dummy run costs ~0.5 GPU-h of the 30 available after the 26 Sep 00:00 reset); LB slots (1-2 of 21); runtime (the author's scored run proves it fits in 12 h, and x138's REPAIR_DEADLINE_S=27000 guard applies); friend A (not needed). The cited numbers check out: Tennant 0.959 and Pothula 0.956 (pass2 l.110-111), the 24 Sep histogram, and x138 = readmit-v1 + head. The numbers are just stale: Tennant is now rank 45, not 32.
